items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had a thing from Moe Gale, Schiffman, and Joe Glaser to do all the theaters... Schiffman came -- I was rehearsing downstairs... So he said, 'I'm gonna let you bring your band in.'

ctx.x: But from your recordings in 1956, you didn't record between that time. You, yourself, didn't really record very much until "Mr. Bear."
No, I didn't anything up (inaudible) after that.
During '46 and '47, that's when I built that big band. That's when I had the big band. I only had that one big band.
